GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward ended up 2nd 1 length . laid out rounding home turn , hit front for a stride. Battled On Well before beginning to tire # had Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event. Laid out under pressure rounding the home turn and in the straight

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled 5th in between runners 2 Lengths . held up into Straight , got Clear near 200m, looked as though he might run a place but he peaked on his effort Inside 100m # peaked late/fitter
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running on entering the straight, was  disappointed for a run inside the 300m and was obliged to shift in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled 4th on rail 3 Lengths . saved ground into Straight , Battled On Well enough to finish 3rd # boxed on okay
Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled close 2nd holding Inside . Took over & kicked away into Straight . overhauled approaching 100m, gave in Quickly (vet - no visible abnormalities) # weak when counted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: laid out in the straight. RR the gelding over raced in the early stages of the event. Vet NVA.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Tongue Tie off, Blinkers again) Jumped Ok Took A Sit 5th 4 Lengths . was out 4 & Five Wide approaching home turn . Straightened Up within 2 Lengths of the Leader . peaked on his effort near 100m # came wide/peaked
jumped in air at start and missed kick 3 Lengths , got back 2nd last 6 Lengths 800m, off heels and in Clear Straightening Up , battled away last 200m, Tongue Tie again # battled away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly and lost ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Just Off Mid-Field on rail 8 Lengths . had Good Run Through along rail into Straight to be 2 Lengths from the Leader , Battled On Well to just miss a place in a queue for the minors # ground saving ride
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jumped away awkwardly. Held up for clear running to inside the  200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 2 Lengths 800m, off heels and looked winning chance Straightening Up , loomed at 200m but Just peaked soon after and had to settle for minor placing # held placing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: fractious in the barrier after being loaded. Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was deemed suitable to start. Near the 800m was steadied when awkwardly placed near the heels of a/r.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , drove Through and shared lead rails 800m, got the better of rival at 200m and looked home but he Just found one better from the back and had to settle for second spot, blinkers off first time # overran late
Jumped Ok Went Forward led by 2 Lengths . Same To The Turn , overhauled near 200m, faded to miss a place # led/no excuses
Jumped Ok Ridden Along out Wide With Cover in 6th 4 Lengths . Under Whip coming To The Turn , Dropped Out in Straight (vet - no visible abnormalities) # never travelled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: rider reported that the gelding did not appreciate racing on the dirt track. vet NVA

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Ridden Along touch Worse than midfield Wide 5 Lengths 700m, Hard Ridden and going nowhere soon after Straightening Up , angled widest at 200m and he made good late ground but from too far back # best work late
